steps.name: environment
steps.description: Ensure Node >=18, verify or install Supabase CLI only if missing or below a minimum version (if MIN_SUPABASE_VERSION env var set). Persist lightweight environment defaults (PATH for npm global bin and SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_ANON_KEY placeholders) in /etc/profile.d/supabase_env.sh atomically and idempotently. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-classic-324324/database.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-classic-324324/database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Verify node >=18
NODE_V=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || true)
[ -n "$NODE_V" ] || { echo "node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
NODE_V=${NODE_V#v}
MAJOR=${NODE_V%%.*}
if [ "${MAJOR:-0}" -lt 18 ]; then echo "node >=18 required, found $NODE_V" >&2; exit 2; fi
# Detect supabase CLI and optionally compare semver if MIN_SUPABASE_VERSION set
SUP_BIN=$(command -v supabase || true)
SUP_VER=""
if [ -n "$SUP_BIN" ]; then SUP_VER=$(supabase --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true); fi
# If MIN_SUPABASE_VERSION provided, perform a simple semver compare on major.minor.patch
if [ -n "${MIN_SUPABASE_VERSION:-}" ] && [ -n "$SUP_VER" ]; then
  # normalize digits: compare lexicographically on major minor patch
  ver_ok=0
  IFS=. read -r rmaj rmin rpatch <<<'${SUP_VER//[!0-9.]/}' || true
  IFS=. read -r mmaj mmin mpatch <<<'${MIN_SUPABASE_VERSION//[!0-9.]/}' || true
  rmaj=${rmaj:-0}; rmin=${rmin:-0}; rpatch=${rpatch:-0}
  mmaj=${mmaj:-0}; mmin=${mmin:-0}; mpatch=${mpatch:-0}
  if [ "$rmaj" -gt "$mmaj" ] || { [ "$rmaj" -eq "$mmaj" ] && { [ "$rmin" -gt "$mmin" ] || { [ "$rmin" -eq "$mmin" ] && [ "$rpatch" -ge "$mpatch" ]; }; }; }; then ver_ok=1; fi
  if [ "$ver_ok" -ne 1 ]; then SUP_BIN=""; SUP_VER=""; fi
fi
# Install supabase CLI only if not present after checks
if [ -z "$SUP_BIN" ]; then
  # Respect image policy: install via npm non-interactively
  npm i -g supabase --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo "failed to install supabase CLI" >&2; exit 3; }
  SUP_BIN=$(command -v supabase || true)
  SUP_VER=$(supabase --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
fi
# Ensure npm global bin is on PATH for future shells
NPM_GLOB_BIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo "/usr/local/bin")
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/supabase_env.sh
TMP=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMP" <<- 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Added by env-001: ensure npm global bin in PATH and provide SUPABASE placeholders
export PATH="%NPM_BIN%:$PATH"
export SUPABASE_URL="${SUPABASE_URL:-http://localhost:54321}"
export SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="${SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:-anon}"
EOF
sed -i "s|%NPM_BIN%|$NPM_GLOB_BIN|g" "$TMP"
# Atomic, idempotent replace
if ! sudo test -f "$PROFILE" || ! sudo cmp -s "$TMP" "$PROFILE"; then sudo mv "$TMP" "$PROFILE" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"; else rm -f "$TMP"; fi
# Validate supabase and record evidence
command -v supabase >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "supabase CLI not found on PATH after install" >&2; exit 4; }
echo "NODE_VERSION=$NODE_V" >/tmp/tool_versions_node.txt || true
supabase --version >/tmp/tool_versions_supabase.txt 2>&1 || true
npm --version >/tmp/tool_versions_npm.txt 2>&1 || true
exit 0

steps.name: dependencies
steps.description: Install minimal OS packages non-interactively if missing (postgres client). Install local jest devDependency only if tests require it and no suitable global jest available. Use npm ci when package-lock.json exists. Record tool versions for evidence. Operates in workspace.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-classic-324324/database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Ensure psql exists; install minimal client if missing
if ! command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends postgresql-client; fi
command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "psql missing" >&2; exit 4; }
# Deterministic npm install: prefer npm ci when package-lock.json exists
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo "npm ci failed" >&2; exit 5; }
else
  # If tests exist and no local jest, rely on global jest if present; otherwise install local jest devDependency
  if [ -f package.json ] && ! [ -x "./node_modules/.bin/jest" ]; then
    if ! command -v jest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent --save-dev jest@29 || { echo "failed installing jest locally" >&2; exit 6; }
    fi
  fi
fi
# Record versions for debugging
psql --version >/tmp/tool_versions_psql.txt 2>&1 || true
jest --version >/tmp/tool_versions_jest.txt 2>&1 || true
exit 0

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Validate full environment: build, start server (via start-001), wait for readiness (longer wait), run HTTP smoke check, optionally check DB connectivity using environment parameters (PGHOST/PGPORT/PGUSER/PGPASSWORD or SUPABASE_URL), capture evidence files for node/npm/supabase/psql/jest and HTTP body snippet, then stop the server cleanly. Operates in workspace.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-classic-324324/database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
# Build to ensure dist/ exists
npm run build --silent || { echo "build failed" >&2; exit 6; }
# Start server deterministically; fail-fast on error
PORT=$PORT bash ./start || { echo "start script failed; see /tmp/db_server.log" >&2; exit 7; }
# Wait for pidfile
MAX_WAIT_SEC=10
i=0
while [ $i -lt $MAX_WAIT_SEC ] && [ ! -f /tmp/db_server.pid ]; do sleep 0.5; i=$((i+1)); done
[ -f /tmp/db_server.pid ] || { echo "pidfile missing after start" >&2; cat /tmp/db_server.log 2>/dev/null || true; exit 7; }
PID=$(cat /tmp/db_server.pid)
# Poll server for readiness with more generous timeout
SUCCESS=0
for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do
  STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/ || true)
  [ "$STATUS" = "200" ] && { SUCCESS=1; break; }
  sleep 0.5
done
if [ $SUCCESS -ne 1 ]; then echo "server did not respond with 200 (last=$STATUS)" >&2; cat /tmp/db_server.log 2>/dev/null || true; kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f /tmp/db_server.pid; exit 7; fi
BODY=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/ | head -c 200)
# DB connectivity: attempt connection if PGHOST/PGPORT/PGUSER/PGPASSWORD or SUPABASE_URL provided
PSQL_OK=0
if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ -n "${PGHOST:-}${PGPORT:-}${PGUSER:-}${PGPASSWORD:-}" ]; then
    PGPASSFILE=/tmp/pgpass_tmp
    # use psql with provided env vars; psql will pick up PG* env vars
    if PGPASSWORD="${PGPASSWORD:-}" psql -h "${PGHOST:-localhost}" -p "${PGPORT:-5432}" -U "${PGUSER:-$(whoami)}" -Atc "SELECT 1;" >/tmp/psql_check.txt 2>&1; then PSQL_OK=1; else PSQL_OK=0; fi
  elif [ -n "${SUPABASE_URL:-}" ]; then
    # Try to parse host:port from SUPABASE_URL (simple parse)
    HOSTPORT=$(echo "${SUPABASE_URL}" | sed -E 's/^https?:\/\///' | cut -d'/' -f1)
    H=$(echo "$HOSTPORT" | cut -d':' -f1)
    P=$(echo "$HOSTPORT" | cut -s -d':' -f2)
    if [ -n "$H" ]; then
      if psql -h "$H" -p "${P:-5432}" -Atc "SELECT 1;" >/tmp/psql_check.txt 2>&1; then PSQL_OK=1; else PSQL_OK=0; fi
    else
      echo "SUPABASE_URL present but host parse failed; skipping psql check" >/tmp/psql_check.txt || true
      PSQL_OK=0
    fi
  else
    echo "DB connection params not provided; skipping psql check" >/tmp/psql_check.txt || true
    PSQL_OK=0
  fi
else
  echo "psql not available; skipping DB check" >/tmp/psql_check.txt || true
  PSQL_OK=0
fi
# Capture tool versions
node -v >/tmp/validation_node_version.txt 2>&1 || true
npm -v >/tmp/validation_npm_version.txt 2>&1 || true
